scope: Offline reproduction, production installer --check, complete build and regression tests; no physical device flash writes performed

gpt.root_cause: The old preservation check compares FIP LastLBA fields byte-for-byte. OEM BL33/FIP sizes differ despite identical 4ge BL2/BL31 and fixed slot starts.
gpt.fix: Allow only the first two GPT entries LastLBA fields to vary; validate fixed starts, slot bounds, primary/backup agreement and capacity for every proposed FIP payload. Retain CRC, other layout/reserved bytes, BL2/BL31 and package certificate checks. Keep local GPT unchanged.
